quarantined.explanation: C64 Lemon64 credits same publisher but release year 1990, not MAME 1989. Do not invent a universal year until edition reconciled.
Two distinct C64 games share title: Interceptor Software 1984 and The Power House 1988. Exact title does not identify playable binary.

Two different C64 games titled Armageddon were released in 1983. Ocean published the Missile Command-style shooter; Visions Software Factory published a strategy/board game. Current emulator contains two differently hashed standalone PRG files. A company-list page cannot establish which file is which; do not assign a shared publisher to this title key until binary/visual identity is verified.
Lemon64 dates C64 title 1987 and credits Encore, but also records Elite full-price magazine release and later Encore/Hit-Pak budget edition; hosted binary edition unconfirmed.
C64 light-gun Gunslinger (Virgin Mastertronic, 1990) and C64 adventure Gunslinger (Datasoft/US Gold, 1987) share title. No binary identity established.
MAME identifies the 1989 Mastertronic Plus reissue; C64 original 1985 publishers include New Generation Software (Europe) and Mastertronic (US).
MAME The Hit Squad is budget reissue; original C64 release 1986 was published by Ocean and developed by Sensible Software.
MAME Firebird Silver is a re-release; original 1986 C64 game The Prodigy was published by Electric Dreams.
Americana is later reissue of the 1984 C64 Sentinel released by Synapse Software (US) / US Gold (Europe).

Exact title in MAME does not establish which C64 regional/reissue edition is hosted. Lemon64 identifies Imagine as European 1987 publisher, ERBE as Spanish release, The Hit Squad as 1990 budget re-release; US release is titled Alcon. Keep uncredited rather than apply Erbe to every Slap Fight binary.
Two distinct C64 games named Snare: Thalamus 1989 and Beyond Belief 1993. Title alone cannot identify the file.

quarantined.explanation: MAME The Hit Squad issue is a budget re-release; original Commodore 64 1988 version published by Domark.
Americana is a later European reissue of Richard Petty's Talladega; original C64 editions have different regional publishers including Cosmi, US Gold and Audiogenic.
C64 Wizardry has The Edge as European publisher and Mindscape as US publisher. Need hosted binary region before universal attribution.
MAME The Hit Squad is 1989 budget reissue; original C64 World Series Baseball was published by Imagine in 1985.
Two different C64 titles named Zodiac: Anirog Software 1984 shoot'em up and Incentive Software 1987 adventure.

independentlyVerified.scope: C64 publisher/year credits confirmed against specified Lemon64 C64 pages; does not independently establish binary edition

entries.reviewNote: Lemon64 lists Capcom (US), ERBE Software (Spain), GO! (Europe), Tiertex developer and Kixx (1990) re-release. C64 originally US 1987, Europe 1988.
Encore is listed as publisher; EDOS is a re-releaser and Elite/Hit-Pak are copyright credits.
Source identifies 1989 Batman: The Movie, Ocean publisher, The Hit Squad subsequent budget re-release; not generic attribution to other Batman games.
Lemon64 credits Mirrorsoft as publisher and Image Works as developer. Magazine review release-label variations are not substituted for publisher.

Lemon64 C64 Fairlight: A Prelude (1986) lists The Edge publisher; Softek copyright credit, Bo Jangeborg creator, Trevor Inns C64 conversion, The Micro Selection budget re-release; C64 variant distinct from other platforms.

Lemon64 European C64 Flying Shark release (1987) credits Firebird as publisher and Catalyst Coders as developer; Taito is arcade copyright/license. US Sky Shark is a separate regional C64 release with Taito publisher; do not conflate the two.
Lemon64 C64 Gunship 1986 publisher MicroProse Software; Kixx is subsequent budget reissue. C128 enhancement in C64 mode does not establish a separate publisher.
Lemon64 C64 Impact! (1988) credited to Audiogenic, developed by Reptilia Design. Blockbuster is noted as an alternative US title; do not infer all generic Impact binaries are this game.
Lemon64 European C64 Quedex (1987), publisher Thalamus, Kixx is 1990 budget re-release. Mindroll is distinct US region variant; identity must be confirmed before linking.

Lemon64 specifically identifies the 1988 C64 Mirrorsoft edition, developed by Andromeda Software, Mastertronic Plus budget re-release. Generic Tetris title may be another version; binary identity remains unverified.
Lemon64 C64 entry names The Catacombs and credits Anirog Software; leading-article title normalization only, physical PRG edition not identified.
Lemon64 C64 Galivan: Cosmo Police credits Imagine as publisher, Nihon Bussan as copyright; no other-platform publisher substituted.
Lemon64 C64 Garfield: Big, Fat, Hairy Deal credits The Edge as publisher and Softek as copyright; short emulator title may need binary-edition confirmation.
Lemon64 C64 Hustler credits Bubble Bus original publisher, Top Ten is a later re-releaser; regional renamed release Minnesota Fat's Pool Challenger is not conflated.
Lemon64 C64 Matrix/Gridrunner 2 credits Llamasoft, originally 1983 Europe; the US release uses the different name AMC: Attack of the Mutant Camels.

bulkInheritedBatch.scope: Existing credited C64 title only; one packed game record per key and no parent-title PRG hash collision
